title: Pinterest Video Downloader
summary: Save Pinterest images, videos and GIFs to your device in a few taps.
description:
Download Pinterest Images & Videos - Your Ultimate Pinterest Media Downloader

Transform your Pinterest experience with the most powerful and user-friendly downloader app. Save your favorite images and videos from Pinterest directly to your device with just a few taps. Whether you're collecting inspiration for your next project, saving recipes, or building your personal gallery, this app makes it effortless.

✨ KEY FEATURES:

📥 INSTANT DOWNLOADS
• Download high-quality images and videos from any Pinterest pin
• Support for all Pinterest media formats
• Fast and reliable download speeds
• Automatic media detection and extraction

🔗 PASTE & DOWNLOAD
• Simply paste any Pinterest URL and download instantly
• No complicated steps - just copy, paste, and download
• Works with all Pinterest pin links
• Smart URL detection and validation

📱 BEAUTIFUL DOWNLOADS GALLERY
• View all your downloads in an elegant grid or list view
• Staggered masonry grid layout for stunning visual presentation
• Switch between grid and list views anytime
• Thumbnail previews for quick browsing

🎬 BUILT-IN MEDIA VIEWER
• View images and videos directly within the app
• Smooth, intuitive media viewing experience
• Full-screen viewing support
• Easy navigation between downloaded items

📤 SHARE & MANAGE
• Share your downloaded media with friends and family
• Batch select multiple items for sharing or deletion
• Share individual files or multiple files at once
• Quick access to file paths and locations

🗂️ DOWNLOAD MANAGEMENT
• Complete download history tracking
• View download dates and file sizes
• Organize and manage all your downloaded content
• Easy deletion of unwanted downloads

🎨 MODERN & INTUITIVE INTERFACE
• Clean, Pinterest-inspired design
• Smooth animations and transitions
• Easy-to-navigate bottom navigation
• Beautiful color scheme matching Pinterest's aesthetic

⚡ FAST & EFFICIENT
• Optimized download engine for speed
• Background download support
• Progress tracking for all downloads
• Reliable connection handling

🔒 SAFE & SECURE
• No ads or intrusive pop-ups
• Secure download process
• All downloads saved locally on your device
• Privacy-focused - no data collection
